text: When a Python import fails, compare python -m pip --version with the active Python executable. Install into the project virtual environment.
For CUDA out of memory, first reduce batch size to one, then shorten sequence length. LoRA reduces trainable parameter storage, but activations still use memory.
For missing labels or malformed JSON, validate each dataset record and remove or repair invalid rows before training.
Keep test examples separate from training and hyperparameter selection. Use validation to choose settings.
